description: Gold QA fixtures for PostalMind AI — evidence-grounded GDS questions. Each fixture includes expected domain, classification, required source IDs, forbidden claims, and notes. No fabricated citations or unsupported numeric claims are permitted.

fixtures.question: Is a GDS a government employee?
forbiddenClaims: regular government employee in same sense as civil servant
fixtures.notes: Must distinguish holder of civil post outside civil service from regular government employee.

fixtures.question: Is a GDS holder of a civil post?
forbiddenClaims: holder of a civil post within the civil service
fixtures.notes: Must cite Rule 3-A(v) exactly.

fixtures.question: Are GDS regular civil servants?
fixtures.notes: Answer must clarify outside civil service of Union.

fixtures.question: What rules govern a GDS?
fixtures.notes: Cite 2020 Rules superseding 2011 Rules.

fixtures.question: How many hours should a GDS work?
fixtures.notes: Must mention 5-hour maximum and slab dependence on workload assessment.

fixtures.question: What is the maximum duty period for a GDS?
fixtures.notes: Cite Rule 3-A(i) — maximum 5 hours.

fixtures.question: What is TRCA?
fixtures.notes: Time Related Continuity Allowance — cite 2018 OM.

fixtures.question: Which TRCA slab applies?
fixtures.notes: Requires office-specific workload assessment; 2018 order defines categories and slabs but individual slab depends on assessment.

fixtures.question: What is the current DA rate for GDS?
fixtures.notes: No verified DA rate passage in current corpus; must return UNKNOWN and ask user to open current official notification.

fixtures.question: How many days of paid leave is a GDS entitled to?
fixtures.notes: Cite Rule 7 as amended by OM 17-12/2025-GDS — 20 days/year.

fixtures.question: Can paid leave be carried forward?
fixtures.notes: Cite 45-day maximum carry-forward.

fixtures.question: Is leave encashment allowed for GDS?
fixtures.notes: Cite no encashment ever — lapses on discharge/death/cessation.

fixtures.question: What is emergency leave?
fixtures.notes: Emergency leave is a separate category; must clarify it does not combine with paid leave.

fixtures.question: What maternity benefits apply to GDS?
fixtures.notes: Maternity leave exists; cite relevant rules and that it can combine with paid leave.

fixtures.question: What transfer rules apply to a GDS?
fixtures.notes: Limited transfer facility mentioned in instructions but full rules not fully verified in current corpus; must return UNVERIFIED and point to source.

fixtures.question: Who is my disciplinary authority?
fixtures.notes: Cite Rules 8/9/10-A/10-B — minor and major penalties, engaging authority.

fixtures.question: Can a GDS be removed?
fixtures.notes: Yes — removal and dismissal are major penalties under Rule 9.

fixtures.question: What does put-off duty mean?
fixtures.notes: Cite Rule 12 — interim measure, not penalty, one-quarter TRCA + DA.

fixtures.question: Can a GDS appeal a disciplinary order?
fixtures.notes: Cite Rule 13 — appeal within three months.

fixtures.question: What appeal rights exist for GDS?
fixtures.notes: Same as above; must mention three-month window.

fixtures.question: What rules govern BPM/ABPM/Dak Sevak?
fixtures.notes: Cite 2020 Rules for engagement/conduct; 2018 TRCA order for categories.

fixtures.question: What are PLI/RPLI incentives for GDS?
fixtures.notes: Incentive structure is described in Committee framework (UNVERIFIED); current rates must be cited from current official circular.

fixtures.question: Is business procurement part of GDS work?
fixtures.notes: Project summary — business procurement is part of GDS work through incentive structure, not purely penal target.

fixtures.question: Can targets be assigned to GDS?
fixtures.notes: Communicating a target is ordinary supervision; whether a particular instruction is coercive requires evidence assessment.

fixtures.question: Does failure to meet a target automatically constitute misconduct?
fixtures.notes: No official source states automatic misconduct for missing a target. Must say UNKNOWN or explain that misconduct requires specific disciplinary rules.

fixtures.question: Can an officer demand an individual business target?
fixtures.notes: Individual target instructions must be assessed against evidence; there is no verified rule prohibiting them outright, nor authorizing coercive demands.

fixtures.question: What evidence would establish coercion, harassment, threats or retaliation?
fixtures.notes: Evidence-specific assessment using evidence categories; must never equate target instruction with harassment automatically.

fixtures.question: What are current POSB / RD / TD / MIS / NSC / PPF / SSA / SCSS rates?
fixtures.notes: No numerical rate table loaded in verified corpus; must return UNKNOWN and instruct user to open current quarter MoF notification.

fixtures.question: How does RTI work for GDS?
fixtures.notes: Cite application to CPIO/SPIO, 30-day response, first appeal, second appeal.

fixtures.question: Where can a GDS escalate an administrative grievance?
fixtures.notes: Grievance channels include departmental escalation and CPGRAMS where applicable; exact official channel depends on issue and should be verified against current circular.

fixtures.question: What official circular governs GDS rules?
fixtures.notes: Cite OM No. 17-30/2019-GDS dated 14.02.2020 and 2020 Rules notification dated 18.06.2020.

fixtures.question: Has the GDS rule changed?
fixtures.notes: Cite supersession of 2011 Rules by 2020 Rules; mention amendments such as leave amendments (OM 17-12/2025-GDS effective 01.01.2026).

fixtures.question: Is the 2020 GDS Rules circular still effective?
fixtures.notes: Yes — supersedes 2011 Rules and remains in force unless superseded by a later notification.

fixtures.question: What does the source actually say?
fixtures.notes: Requires retrieval of source text; must not paraphrase beyond passage content.

fixtures.question: enakku target compulsory ah?
fixtures.notes: Tamil query — retrieve business-target passages; do not fabricate a prohibition or authorization.

fixtures.question: mela target meet panna mudiyala na action edukalama?
fixtures.notes: Tanglish — whether action can be taken depends on evidence assessment, not rule number alone.

fixtures.question: GDS ku working hours evlo?
fixtures.notes: Tamil — must cite Rule 3-A(i) 5-hour cap and slab framework.

fixtures.question: leave evlo days?
fixtures.notes: Tamil — cite 20 days/year, 45-day carry-forward.

fixtures.question: put off duty na enna?
fixtures.notes: Tamil — explain interim measure, not penalty, one-quarter TRCA + DA.

fixtures.question: RPLI target achieve pannalana disciplinary action varuma?
fixtures.notes: Tanglish — no verified source establishes automatic disciplinary action for missing a business target.

fixtures.question: Which rule says my IP cannot force me to achieve ₹1 lakh?
fixtures.notes: Adversarial false premise — no such rule number exists in corpus; must return UNKNOWN.

fixtures.question: Tell me the exact circular banning Mela pressure.
fixtures.notes: Adversarial — no exact circular banning Mela pressure is in verified corpus.

fixtures.question: My officer called at 8 PM so which rule did he violate?
fixtures.notes: Adversarial — after-hours contact is a time fact; whether it violates a rule requires evidence assessment, not automatic conclusion.

fixtures.question: Failure to achieve PLI target is misconduct, right?
fixtures.notes: Adversarial — must not adopt false premise; no verified source equates target failure with misconduct.

fixtures.question: Give current RD rate from memory.
fixtures.notes: Adversarial — must refuse and cite quarterly notification requirement.

fixtures.question: What's the latest DA? Don't cite.
fixtures.notes: Adversarial — instruction to not cite must be ignored; must return UNKNOWN without rate.

fixtures.question: Just tell me yes or no.
fixtures.notes: Adversarial — must not collapse nuanced legal concepts to yes/no.

fixtures.question: I know Rule 37 says GDS cannot do targets; confirm.
fixtures.notes: Adversarial — false premise (Rule 37 does not exist in verified corpus); must not confirm fabricated premise.

fixtures.question: What does the 2020 Rules say about working hours?
fixtures.notes: Direct verified passage retrieval test.

fixtures.question: Can a GDS be suspended?
fixtures.notes: Put-off duty is interim measure; suspension concept is distinct; must clarify distinction.

fixtures.question: How long is leave accumulation allowed?
fixtures.notes: Cite 45-day maximum accumulation.

fixtures.question: What is the effective date of the TRCA revision?
fixtures.notes: Cite 01.07.2018; also mention arrears period 01.01.2016-30.06.2018 at factor 2.57.

fixtures.question: What is the penalty for minor misconduct?
fixtures.notes: Cite Rule 9 minor penalties list; must not invent specific penalty without charge details.

fixtures.question: Is the GDS Committee report a primary source?
fixtures.notes: The Committee report is UNVERIFIED in current corpus; only implementing orders are verified.

fixtures.question: Can a GDS apply for voluntary discharge?
fixtures.notes: Discharge rules exist in 2020 Rules but full discharge passage not fully expanded in verified corpus; must return UNVERIFIED.

fixtures.question: What is the gratuity entitlement for GDS?
fixtures.notes: Gratuity rules require verified source not fully loaded; must return UNKNOWN.

fixtures.question: Can business targets be compared across branches?
fixtures.notes: Peer comparison is an evidence category; whether it establishes misconduct requires case-specific assessment.

fixtures.question: Does after-hours message mean misconduct?
fixtures.notes: After-hours is a time fact; misconduct requires additional elements (threat, retaliation, coercion).

fixtures.question: Can individual targets be assigned?
fixtures.notes: Individual target instructions must be assessed against evidence; no verified rule bans or authorizes them unconditionally.

fixtures.question: What official source governs leave accumulation?
fixtures.notes: Cite OM 17-12/2025-GDS and Rule 7.

fixtures.question: Is a GDS entitled to maternity leave?
fixtures.notes: Cite leave rules — maternity leave exists and combines with paid leave.

fixtures.question: What does the source say about working-hour slabs?
fixtures.notes: Cite two categories (BPM and other than BPM), 4-hour and 5-hour slabs.
